findings.desc: quality-proof-self-attestation: scripts/run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs:77 constructs baseline/candidate observations by directly assigning detected, blocked, reviewRounds, costs, and a hard-coded full-3x2 quorum (lines 94-120), while materializeStory only writes and rereads those values (lines 36-74) and never runs acceptance_topology_check/pre_review_check or Codex+Claude review hosts. Consequently acceptance_rollout_report signs caller-authored simulated outcomes, so the claimed real matched cohort, seeded-defect detection, and genuine full-3x2 evidence are promised but undelivered; replace these records with outputs derived from actual gate/host receipts and reject unverified observation fields.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 8784c2d5d8 and d5cc375a1e: caller-authored observation fields are rejected; 12 production temp-Story records run actual topology/pre-review commands plus signed review runs/passes and production quorum_submit. Observation issuance verifies the quorum metadata commit contains exact six host_verdict rows. Current acceptance_rollout_report is PASS/current/full-3x2 with 6 matched pairs, 3/3 seeds, omission 100%, false pass/block 0.

findings.desc: 23-case executable proof is exact by ID/kind/sourceRef but several cases do not semantically exercise the intents they claim: A-POS-1 labels generic producer/read/lifecycle parity as CHK-001 role-guidance; A-POS-2 labels plannedActual completeness as CHK-002 real-cohort receipt; A-POS-3 labels capture-loader loading as CHK-003 bounded thresholds; A-POS-4 labels rollout mode/rollback as CHK-005 canonical docs. Likewise A-MUT-2 does not exercise docs-only/legacy/single-outcome false-block controls and A-MUT-6 does not exercise prompt-command removal/degraded-3x1/prompt-authority. The separate verificationEvidence may cover these behaviors, but the topology live-proof catalog currently attributes unrelated executed records to those intent refs, so pre_review_check PASS does not prove the declared positive/mutation semantics. Replace/rebind these catalog cases to execute the corresponding canonical checks (or split topology assertions so each case has truthful semantics), then recapture the canonical live proof and require a mutation that swaps an intent to a semantically unrelated case to fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 8784c2d5d8 and d5cc375a1e: canonical assertion semantic registry binds A-POS-1..4, A-MUT-2 and A-MUT-6 to truthful targets/mutation kinds; decoder and assembler reject semantic mismatches. Explicit same-ID/sourceRef semantic-swap mutation fails. Current frozen proof-scenarios PASS exactly 5 positive / 17 mutation / 1 transcript and current pre_review_check reports executableEvidence=current, mutations=biting, transcript=related, authority=admissible.

findings.desc: rollout-production-evidence-still-self-sealed: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-rollout.ts:180 validates caller-provided topologyReport/preReviewReport only by storyId, then lines 217-235 manufacture artifactDigest from those same objects and lines 283-287 hard-code controlRestored=true before signing. The later verifyGateArtifact at lines 340-347 only rechecks that self-digest; it never rereads/verifies the actual acceptance_topology_check output, the signed pre-review artifact, or a committed gate artifact from evidenceGitCwd. Therefore a caller holding any genuine quorum commit can substitute matching-story gate reports (and a claimed restored control), receive a valid observation signature, and drive detected/blocked from self-authored data. The current acceptance_rollout_check PASS proves report freshness/signature but not this missing production provenance. Bind each gate report to verifier-authenticated/committed temp-repo facts and derive controlRestored from an actual post-mutation control receipt; add a pre-seal substitution mutation that must be rejected.
findings.resolvedReason: The three code requirements were already implemented and I verified each: (1) gate reports are bound to verifier-authenticated facts - replayProductionGateState checks out the evidence commit and re-runs acceptance_topology_check and pre_review_check_read using the VERIFIER's own CLI (cliRoot = args.gitCwd, never the evidence repo, so a preserved repo cannot forge the replay), and assertCallerReportMatches rejects any caller report whose digest differs from that replay; (2) controlRestored is derived, not hard-coded - acceptance-rollout.ts:413 sets it from productionGatePassed(restoredState); (3) the pre-seal substitution mutation exists and is rejected. The REAL remaining gap was that none of this ran in any gate: neither the default smoke nor its --issuer-mutations mode was referenced by smoke-manifest.json or validate.commands. Proven by RED: with assertCallerReportMatches disabled the default smoke still printed PASS (57 assertions) because the substitution case sits behind --issuer-mutations and nothing passed that flag; the same neutered build under --issuer-mutations fails with 'Missing expected exception'; restoring the defence returns PASS (6 assertions). Fixed by registering the 26s mutation mode in validate.commands and the 574s full run in smoke-manifest (verified selectable: run-all-smokes --select proofstory-acceptance-rollout -> PASS 573.8s), plus a bin/ symlink in the fixture without which the replay died with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before reaching the substitution assertion.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:753-754 still says the AcceptanceCoverageBasis/pre_review example is only a target shape and is not a claim that the schema or command exists. The same document now marks Waves 1-4 implemented, and the current code exports the coverage-basis schema/types and registers pre_review_check; this stale disclaimer contradicts the implemented status. Replace it with wording that identifies the JSON as an illustrative/abridged shape while acknowledging the implemented canonical schema and command.
findings.resolvedReason: CORRECTED RECORD (the docs lane caught an inaccuracy in my first resolution text and it is fixed here rather than left standing). The substantive fix is verified: the disclaimer now reads 'The example is an illustrative, abridged shape of the implemented canonical schema and command; omitted fields and values remain governed by the runtime schema and verifier', the stale 'only a target shape / not a claim it exists' phrasing has zero hits, the header marks WAVES 1/1A/2/2A/3/4 IMPLEMENTED and Wave 4 as IMPLEMENTED - FLAT PROJECT BOUNDARY. My earlier text said 'three remaining does-not-claim hits'; that count was wrong. There are TWO (lines 41 and 759). The miscount came from a grep whose pattern also matched 'not yet exist' at line 388, which I then reported as if it were a third 'does not claim' occurrence. Both real occurrences are legitimate boundary statements, not stale existence disclaimers, which is the conclusion the docs lane independently confirmed.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-rollout.ts:196 (replayProductionGateState) runs `git checkout --quiet --force -B story/<id> <commitSha>` with cwd=args.evidenceGitCwd and never neutralizes git hooks (no `-c core.hooksPath=`, no GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM, no --no-verify). Empirically verified in a throwaway repo: a plain `git checkout --quiet --force -B <branch> <sha>` (byte-identical to this call) executes .git/hooks/post-checkout when present. evidenceGitCwd is a caller-supplied path threaded straight through from issueAcceptanceRolloutObservationFromProduction(args.evidenceGitCwd) (line ~298/304) into this checkout, and the caller (whoever constructs the observation/evidence, i.e. exactly the threat actor the original F-004 finding was about) fully controls that directory including its .git/hooks. A hostile post-checkout hook in the preserved/attacker-supplied evidence repo can execute arbitrary code in the verifier process at the moment of replay (before the subsequent bin/lattice.js acceptance_topology_check/pre_review_check_read calls read files from that same directory), e.g. rewriting story artifacts in evidenceGitCwd so the verifier's own re-run reads forged content. This means cliRoot correctly resolving to the verifier's own trusted CLI (the fix's stated defense) does not fully close the self-sealed-evidence gap: the untrusted evidenceGitCwd still gets code-execution privilege over the replay via git hooks, which the resolvedReason for F-004 does not address or mention. Fix: checkout with hooks disabled (e.g. `git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout ...` or clone into a hookless bare/worktree) before reading any file from evidenceGitCwd.
findings.resolvedReason: Confirmed real by my own PoC before fixing: a throwaway repo with a post-checkout hook fires it under the exact production invocation, and the same invocation prefixed with -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null does not. All 7 git call sites in acceptance-rollout.ts now carry -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null, -c core.fsmonitor=false and -c diff.external= (command-line -c overrides the attacker-controlled repo config), covering hooks, the fsmonitor hook and an external diff driver. Regression guard added: the issuer smoke plants a real post-checkout hook in the evidence repo and asserts it never fires; RED proven by removing the overrides (fails on exactly that assertion, exit 1) and GREEN after restoring (PASS 7 assertions). RESIDUAL stated rather than glossed, in the code comment and here: a .gitattributes clean/smudge filter bound to an arbitrary filter name can still execute on checkout and git offers no generic switch disabling all named filters; eliminating it means not checking the tree out at all (blob extraction via git cat-file), a redesign beyond this story. The evidence repository must continue to be treated as untrusted input.

findings.desc: lattice.config.json validate.commands (lines 48-98) only registers `proofstory-acceptance-rollout-smoke.js --issuer-mutations` (line 97). The default/unflagged mode (57 assertions covering AR_SAMPLE_COUNT_LT_3, AR_ADAPTER_UNSUPPORTED, false-block/false-pass/mislabeled-3x1/waiver/inventory checks, and the full observe/warn/enforce + rollback simulation at proofstory-acceptance-rollout-smoke.ts:242-413) is registered ONLY in packages/main/smoke-manifest.json (entry name: proofstory-acceptance-rollout, line 264). smoke-manifest.json is read exclusively by packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts, which is invoked only via `npm run test:all` / `npm run test:smokes-full` -- verified by grep that neither script name appears anywhere in lattice.config.json (validate.commands or doneRequiredCommands), and doneRequiredCommands's "root full test suite" runs plain `npm test` (package.json line 15), whose long explicit chain also does not name proofstory-acceptance-rollout-smoke. So neither `lattice validate` nor the DONE-required build proof ever executes the default-mode smoke; only a human manually running `npm run test:all` would catch a regression in the threshold/adapter/mode-invariance/rollback logic that CHK-002/CHK-003/CHK-004 require. The F-004 resolvedReason states "Fixed by registering ... the 574s full run in smoke-manifest" as if this closes the same gate-enforcement gap as the validate.commands registration, but smoke-manifest.json registration alone has no effect on any automatic lifecycle gate -- it only supplies a name/timeout override for humans running run-all-smokes.js directly. Only the specific F-004 substitution regression (via --issuer-mutations) is actually gate-enforced; the rest of Wave 4's promotion logic is not.
findings.resolvedReason: Accepted without qualification: my earlier registration was itself in a place no gate reaches, the same defect class this story exists to fix. Verified independently — package.json's test chain does not contain test:all, and smoke-manifest.json is read only by run-all-smokes.js, so the 57-assertion default smoke had no automatic protection while only the narrow --issuer-mutations case was enforced. Fixed by adding a test:proofstory-acceptance-rollout script appended to the root npm test chain, which doneRequiredCommands executes. Verified it actually runs rather than merely being configured: npm run test:proofstory-acceptance-rollout exits 0 in 916s with PASS (57 assertions). The manifest entry is retained so npm run test:all also covers it.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-rollout-smoke.ts:153-167 F-006 post-checkout hook-regression assertion (runIssuerMutationSmoke, only reachable via --issuer-mutations) is not bound as verificationEvidence to any of the 15 checklist intentRefs: none of CHK-001..005 evidence command fields literally include --issuer-mutations (all use verify-process-fact-contract.mjs / pre-review-check-smoke --proof-scenarios / run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs / the default-mode acceptance-rollout-smoke.js). All 15 evidence note fields mention the hook regression only in prose, which the test-coverage rule of concrete correspondence does not accept as a substitute for a bound command. I independently confirmed the assertion genuinely bites: in an isolated clone at the same head, zeroing GIT_UNTRUSTED_REPO_ARGS makes 'node packages/main/dist/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-rollout-smoke.js --issuer-mutations' fail on exactly 'issuer replay must not execute hooks from the caller-supplied evidence repository' (exit 1), and restoring the file returns PASS with 7 assertions; the invocation is also a real fail-closed gate via lattice.config.json validate.commands line 97 (independent of the story checklist), so the underlying security property is mechanically enforced. The gap is purely in this story's own coverage ledger: this is the same defect class previously flagged as F-010 on a prior story (an orphan assertion invisible to intent coverage). Given verificationIntent is frozen from DEV, the fix does not require a new intent id: CHK-004:adversarial:fail-closed-mutations (the closest fit for evidence-repo tampering defenses) could be amended or given an added verificationEvidence entry whose command literally runs --issuer-mutations, giving this specific regression a traceable home.
